_comment: Terrain defence stars. The game DISPLAYS this as 'Def' when you highlight a
tile, so it is directly observable and does not need to be inferred from
damage. Values here are read off that display.
Cross-check: calibration independently derived road=0, plains=1, mountain=4
from damage observations alone, before we knew the display existed. All
three match. That is a genuine confirmation of the damage model, since the
Terrains not listed are UNKNOWN and must be read from the game before use;
they are deliberately absent rather than guessed.

provenance.method: read from the in-game Def display
